# Removal stage 4 — test statements removed, ported or restored

One line per change to a test script made while removing the Design tab — the Grid, Quick Design
and saved Designs, the Specs builder and library, Consulting, and the Estimator's hooks into them
(see docs/removal-log.md, "Stage 4"). Format:

  <file>:<first line>-<last line> [<why>] <first 140 characters of the statement>

Line numbers are the file's at the time of that pass, not today's. Reasons:

  import / import-member   an import of a deleted module, or one name from it (also one name
                           destructured from `await import(...)`)
  TS<code> <message>       a statement that no longer compiled once the imports were gone (most are
                           TS2304 "Cannot find name": the statement used a removed module's export, or a
                           local that only a removed statement defined)
  prop                     one property removed from an object literal (a dependency or field that no
                           longer exists, e.g. `findGrid`, `sections`, `specDocFiles`)
  dead-path <path>         a string naming a deleted source file (a source-pin read)
  dead-path element <path> one deleted path removed from an array of paths that are otherwise live
  dead-dir variable        `const dir = "<a removed screen's folder>"` (reads built from it follow as TS2304)
  dead-dir loop / element  a loop over removed screen folders, or one removed folder taken out of it
  runtime crash            a top-level statement that threw on a removed file, group or settings key
  runtime FAIL <message>   an assertion that pinned removed code or copy and failed when run
  manual: …                a hand edit — an assertion ported to the new behaviour, an import re-pointed at a
                           helper's new module, an "it is gone" check restored, or a suite of a removed
                           feature deleted whole (its link in the suite chain and its function)

Not listed line by line (see docs/removal-log.md): scripts/test-moved-helpers.ts gained the stage-4
wiring pins and had three stage-3 pins updated; scripts/smoke-routes.ts lost 47 routes of removed
screens; scripts/inventory.ts lost one unused import; `quoteSpecParts` was renamed
`quotePackageParts` in the test scripts (7 places) before the prune. Deleted whole:
scripts/test-room-shape.ts, scripts/test-grid-options.ts.
